description: Hi, I’m Koushik, a software engineer in the Bay Area taking on the Earth System Trend Detective challenge solo. I’m building Earth Trend Detective: pick any place on Earth and it uses 45 years of NASA data to show what has really changed, tests whether each trend is real, and explains it in plain English. I care about clean design and AI you can actually trust. Always happy to connect with people who love climate data, stats or web development.
